scope: Post hoc SoH-only inner diagnostic; CALB excluded from training and validation. Fixed configurations; not equal hyperparameter search budgets.

specification.classical_input: same tensor flattened to 2880; no engineered extras
specification.train_sample: at most32 eligible SoH anchors/cell, rounded linspace positions; full cohort before fit
specification.sample_weight: inverse selected count/cell, normalized to mean1; identical objective in all families
specification.cycle_scaler: accepted train-only per-cell capped256 cycle reservoir, including full train profiles
specification.target_scaler: accepted train-only scaler; only SoH transform contributes to learning
specification.labels_read: existing inner multitask loader/scaler reads inner SoH/RUL; RUL has no loss or selection role

neural.loss: weighted absolute error in original SoH units
neural.output: SoH q50 only; inverse train mean/std before loss, no prediction bounds in loss
neural.epoch_order: all selected anchors exactly once; per-epoch seeded permutation
neural.stop: logical patience5 prefix; continue to epoch30, never select beyond prefix
neural.selection: full validation MAE: mean cells within source then mean sources; min improvement1e-8

specification.validation: all eligible SoH windows; raw predictions and same bounds[0,1.5] for scoring
specification.interpretation: paired preprocessing effect primary; family ranking secondary; not equal HPO/compute
specification.chronology: Designed after CALB outer inspection and fixed-model scale diagnosis; cap chosen post hoc.

checkpoint: all completed neural epochs and 16-tree groups; uncheckpointed work may repeat after interruption
reproduction_limit: Supplied source aggregates can reproduce displayed summaries, not independent predictions or cell-level scoring. Native replay receipts cover the first validation batch only.
